text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the Japanese Derby approached, public 
attention was reaching a fever pitch...—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"—Though she bypassed the Satsuki Sho due 
to injury, as what one could call last 
year's Junior Class champion, she is 
poised to take center stage in this 
Derby—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"—Speaking of which, Yaeno Muteki would 
have to be the strongest contender, 
wouldn't you say? Her performance in the 
Satsuki Sho was simply magnificent—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"—We must not overlook Sakura Chiyono O 
either, who left a strong impression in 
the Asahi Hai. Having shown consistently 
stable running since last year, she is 
more than capable of competing—"

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
"—Can Mejiro Ardan live up to the towering 
legacy of her older sister, Ramonu? That 
will surely be one of the key questions 
today—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The media consensus seems to strongly 
favor the horse girl crowned last year's 
Junior Division champion as the top 
candidate for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, from my perspective, I honestly 
have a few doubts about that analysis. The 
reason being—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and Sakura Chiyono O. That's 
because I've seen firsthand the tremendous 
growth the two of them have shown since 
entering the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And oddly enough... the same was true for 
Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I believed that Mejiro Ardan's 
greatest immediate rivals would be the two 
of them: Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno 
Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With such curious thoughts lingering in my 
mind, I left my room and headed off to 
train with Mejiro Ardan—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, that evening...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan was pushing herself with an 
unprecedented level of intensity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Not yet. One more rep...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand getting fired up for the 
Derby. However, she hasn't been acting 
like herself lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was always desperate, but... right 
now, she seemed somewhat impatient.
choice_data_list: Let's call it a day here

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...No. Just a little more, please. I'm 
alright, so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan suddenly collapsed forward—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I managed to support them just in time 
before they collapsed...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I am... so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't turn a blind eye to this any 
longer. At this rate, Mejiro Ardan won't 
even be able to run before she can 
challenge the Nippon Derby...!
choice_data_list:
Any more than this is pushing past the 
limit.

Any more than this is pushing past the 
limit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —I want to push beyond that limit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I do not wish to back down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to give up just because of a 
word like "limit"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have to surpass them "now"...! 
Otherwise...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I... can't win the Japanese Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing the brilliant trail Sister 
blazed... There's no way I could ever do 
that...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —After the Aoba Sho, I realized something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
A single, massive anxiety within me that 
simply cannot be wiped away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No... something I am certain of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I know the passion and dedication Chiyono 
O-san has poured into the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Pure, earnest, and vivid like a cherry 
blossom in full bloom— I know that 
yearning well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I know how strongly Yaeno-san seeks out 
the truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I know of a fighting spirit like a flame— 
greedy, quiet, yet fiercely intense—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You two have always been so kind to me, 
and feeling the warmth of your hearts...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because they are a precious... 
an irreplaceable friend—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: âI can't help but be convinced.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That the two of them will carry those 
feelings, achieve an unparalleled 
radiance, and appear at the "Japan Derby."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"And with how I was at the time of the 
Aoba Sho... I wouldn't be able to defeat 
the two of them as they are now..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That there's no way I could ever surpass 
Sister's majesty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It is essentially just my personal 
intuition. You may dismiss it as mere 
nonsense if you wish. However, I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: I'm sure Ardan's conviction is right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan surely grasps the difference 
in strength between herself and Sakura 
Chiyono O better than I do. I have full 
faith in her judgment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Ardan-san said that earlier, but I 
still believe in her."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"For Ardan-san to run her debut race to 
the end, and to run together with me and 
Yaeno-san!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san's feelings towards racing... 
Even I understand at least a little how 
strong they truly are."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However... I won't lose when it comes to 
feelings! So when we face off one day, 
I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Especially in the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby)... I absolutely will not lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sakura Chiyono O, too, had absolute 
"faith" in Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just as she said... Mejiro Ardan is 
about to face Sakura Chiyono O and the 
others in the "Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I've never asked directly, Yaeno 
Muteki is likely just as convinced. That's 
how strong the bond between these three 
is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the Japanese Derby was a race where 
such special, clashing emotions ran high 
enough to make Mejiro Ardan conscious of 
that bond.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For Mejiro Ardan to win. To establish 
herself beyond the luminous trail of her 
great sister. So that her heartfelt wish 
may be fulfilled—
choice_data_list: Let's train right up to the last minute

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the time remaining, I'll train Mejiro 
Ardan as much as possible and ensure she 
stands safely at the starting gate of the 
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she intends to hone her legs and her 
brilliance to the absolute limit, then I 
will observe that limit with every nerve 
in my body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is my resolve as a Trainer. It is my 
duty as a Trainer, sworn to Mejiro Ardan's 
nanny and her doctor."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You... are always trying to see the same 
view as I do, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Because I'm your trainer, you know.
Because I'm your Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...I am deeply grateful.
choice_data_list:
Let's rest a bit, see how you feel, and 
then push hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
All the time remaining until the Nippon 
Derby... I will turn every bit of it into 
my light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The aurora sparkling high in the heavens. 
I shall overwrite its radiance with my own 
brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: At the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To fulfill these feelings, these wishes—

text_block_list.name: 3 people
text_block_list.text: ――I will win!!!
